title: search.similar
description: Vector-similarity lookup over one registered corpus (VECTOR_CORPORA kind). Embeds the query through the fleet's embedding seam (cached) and answers cosine neighbours above VECTOR_SIMILARITY_FLOOR, best first. Flag-gated: with VECTOR_SUGGEST off the answer is {results: [], degraded: ["vector_disabled"]}; a deployment without pgvector or without a reachable embedder answers {results: [], degraded: ["vector_suggestions"]} — declared, never absorbed.

kind.description: Corpus kind, a key of STAPEL_SEARCH['VECTOR_CORPORA'] (e.g. 'category', 'vocab_label').

q.description: The raw user query. Normalization (VECTOR_QUERY_NORMALIZER) happens inside — callers never pre-fold.

language.description: Language hint handed to the query normalizer.
